notes: Added 2026-10-24 by PLC Studio (verification batch 2, group Verify2) to verify fail-safe and LAD rules against TIA V21; imported with plc_import_documents, compiled, exported with plc_export_block (documents, tool text without BOM). The corpus project was not saved. In the export TIA writes { Type := "" } before Sub, Mul, Div and Mod (the boxes it reports as IsAuto), nothing before the others; the same boxes compile with an explicit type (C36).
